The '''Tusken Bunker''' was the name given to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bunker on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after it was invaded by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The bunker was located on the planet Tatooine, in the rocky [[Desert/Legends|desert]] between [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. It consisted of a one-storied building above the ground with a small watchtower on top and two underground levels. Next to the bunker stood large machines, presumably [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. The area was surrounded by a fortified wall.<ref name="SWG:TB" />

==History==
{{Quote|If you're loyal to the Empire, I have need of your services. The Empire needs you to venture forward and kill as many Sandpeople as you can, specifically in a known region where they have taken control of a key facility. Will you do this for your Emperor?|An Imperial colonel, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aIC" />}}
[[File:Tusken_Bunker_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The main room of the bunker.]]
At some point of time prior to<ref name="SWG:aIC" /> [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sandpeople]] under the lead of a [[Tusken King (rank)|Tusken King]] attacked the bunker, killing many Imperials, and took control of the complex. The Tuskens installed a large [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletonized]] [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] head in the main room where the king resided. Various skeletons of the slain Imperials could still be found in the bunker.<ref name="SWG:aIC" />

In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] tasked citizens with re-securing the facility, albeit in a manner that avoided directly stating that they had lost it in the first place. The colonel also indicated that they had not actually reported their losing the bunker to the Tusken Raiders to [[Prefect (Galactic Empire)|Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]] out of fear of being reprimanded by him.<ref name="SWG:aIC" />

During that time, a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] individual named [[Errik Darksider]] sold the coordinates of the bunker to a spacer traveling through [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:ED">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Errik Darksider|Tatooine}}</ref>
